The complete local conditional proof uses the exact inspected mathematical OU supplier: step 1.1 substitutes sigma^2=2 mu k k_B T_b and gamma=mu k to obtain V=k_B T_b/k; step 1.2 applies its stationary covariance and Fourier-convention spectrum formula; step 1.3 substitutes the same parameters into its finite-time averaging bound. Each conclusion is conditional on the declared positive parameters, stationary Gaussian initial law, and Brownian hypotheses.
